name: board_pass_50
_comment: Wave 7, U9 boarding speed gate: loops/board.mjs walks the player (Kit Crawler 50, 22 px/s, pilot w7_bspeed50) to rest about 60-90 px from the 50,000 Kit Hulk in Kit Board Range, aims at its centre, then crosses it at full speed pressing b every few frames (args.pass); each press is read from the recording (pass_reads in the result). A boarding dialog that opens mid-pass is closed with Abort.
